used_parameters.source_scope: Owner confirms L126583.4m, TMD and270horizontal-axis turbines in3groups; owner construction report cooling L120561m, windL124574m. Motioneering confirms1000ton steel mass,5-floor device, magnets under mass over floor-fixed copper. Actual aerial shows grated circular roof, rectangular lowered well with FULL round oculus and scattered apertures. Exact coordinates/layouts unknown.
used_parameters.dimension_policy: Source-confirmed attributes are separated by *_owner_m or confirmed metadata. Every other numeric value is replaceable visualization candidate; camera/datum/version uncertainty unbounded.
used_parameters.rim_mechanical_device_function: Unconfirmed; actual aerial shows repeated fan-like rim apparatus. Do not label all as air-conditioning units or claim installed count.
used_parameters.helipad_evidence: 待确认：no installed helipad visible in actual aerial or verified primary document; user-requested editable geometry supplied as default-hidden standalone asset parked outside tower, no location claim.
used_parameters.deck_scattered_aperture_evidence: Photo-visible openings, uncalibrated oblique aerial; candidate count/position/dimensions only, not ventilation-function assertion.
used_parameters.cooling_tower_source_conflict: Owner2016construction L120561m adopted; NTUA2014design L128592.47m archived interface. Does not rule out additional groups.
used_parameters.tmd_eye_30m_extent: Owner30m Eye refers to unresolved overall installation extent; not used as sculpture height.
used_parameters.wind_turbine_generic_dimensions_evidence: WINDPODS_PRODUCT_V6 PDFpp2/6 generic G1 length2530mm/diameter460mm/3segments60deg confirmed for generic product only; tower modified-unit dimensions remain unknown. Brochure330+ count and680m height conflict with owner270/632m and are not adopted.
used_parameters.deck_grating_density_evidence: 待确认：actual aerial reads as dense metal grating; display pitch/width only, no calibrated fabrication dimension. Candidate projected coverage 1-(1-.075/.18)^2≈0.660.
used_parameters.tmd_canopy_slot_count_evidence: 至少两孔在业主仰拍中清晰可见；完整6孔及方位为待确认接口，不声称实物全周数量。
used_parameters.v6_retired_canopy: 三瓣cos(3φ)边缘与圆管顶棚撤回；闭合菱形环雕塑撤回。

v8_artist_evidence.uncertainty: Published width axis unspecified; max XY bounding dimension convention. 23m is combined two-floor volume, not forced above L126. Surfaces, tile/slot layout and 2025 asbuilt not obtained.

used_parameters.v8_steel_clearance_method: Actual generated upright crown panes BVH exposed four continuous-curve frame conflicts at0.55m. Added0.55m candidate inward allowance; installed clearance not verified.
used_parameters.tmd_canopy_view_convention: Clockwise from centre outward when viewed from inside below; positive XY phi from outward station

equipment.helipad_evidence: 待确认：no installed helipad visible in actual aerial or verified primary document; user-requested editable geometry supplied as default-hidden standalone asset parked outside tower, no location claim.

crown_detail.uncertainty: Actual image is oblique, uncalibrated. Dimensions, azimuth, counts, exact equipment functions and fabrication sections unbounded; NTUA elevation samples approximately±1.5m plus unresolved datum/version.
